images.note: Real screenshot from Snowflake's own documentation page docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/ui-query-profile, embedded directly in the rendered HTML (verified via curl — this specific docs page, unlike most of docs.snowflake.com, does serve real UI screenshots server-side). Shows an actual Query Profile execution-plan graph: a TableScan operator node feeding 216 rows into a Result node, each annotated with its percentage of total query time — exactly the visual this lesson teaches how to read.
